Repealed. Pub. L. 94–455, title XIX, §1904(a)(10), (11), Oct. 4, 1976, 90 Stat. 1812 ] Section 4294, added Pub. L. 85–859, title I, §135(a), Sept. 2, 1958, 72 Stat. 1292 ; amended Pub. L. 86–344, §2(d), Sept. 21, 1959, 73 Stat. 618 ; Pub. L. 91–72, title I, §101(j)(28), Dec. 30, 1969, 83 Stat. 529 ; Pub. L. 91–258, title II, §205(a)(4), May 21, 1970, 84 Stat. 241 , provided an exemption from tax for services and facilities furnished to a nonprofit educational organization and defined "nonprofit educational organization". Section 4295, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 511 , §4295, formerly §4294, renumbered Sept. 2, 1958, Pub. L. 85–859, title I, §135(a), 72 Stat. 1292 , related to a cross reference to general administrative provisions.
